title: Client Payment Negotiation
summary: This note details a situation where a major recurring customer refused to pay a $125,000 debt, creating conflict between Sales and Finance. The owner analyzed internal systems to find a solution that secured as much payment as possible while preserving the long-term relationship. The proposed compromise involved writing off half the unpaid amount as a courtesy discount and deferring the remaining balance to a future project.

key_points.text: $125,000 owed by a major recurring customer
Conflict between Sales and Finance regarding write-off versus collection
Owner analyzed internal system and found the project would remain net positive overall without the payment
Proposed compromise: write off half of the unpaid amount as a one time courtesy discount
Remaining balance would be deferred into a future project
Result: Win-win solution prevented potential financial loss and protected long-term relationship

related.title: Otis Project Management
related.why: This note details the owner's role as a project manager at Otis, which is the context for the client relationship described.
